summary: Complete GDPR compliance fixes, expand test coverage to employer/admin portals, modularize availableSlots backend, and add performance optimizations including aggregated queries and bundle splitting

phases.name: Sprint 7: Critical GDPR Compliance Fixes
phases.description: Add missing audit logging to consent operations, CSP headers, and error handling

subtasks.description: Add audit logging to createConsent mutation in convex/gdpr.ts. Must call internal.gdpr.logAction with action='consent_created', actorType='employer', resourceType='consent'. Reference existing logAction pattern in processErasure.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit log includes consentType, granted, patientEmail in details

subtasks.description: Add audit logging to withdrawConsent mutation in convex/gdpr.ts. Must call internal.gdpr.logAction with action='consent_withdrawn', actorType='employer', resourceType='consent'.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit log includes consentId, patientId in details

subtasks.description: Add Content-Security-Policy headers to HTTP routes in convex/http.ts. Add CSP middleware that sets default-src 'self', script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', img-src 'self' data: https:, connect-src 'self' https://*.convex.cloud https://api.workos.com
acceptanceCriteria: CSP header added to corsHeaders constant or as separate securityHeaders
All existing HTTP routes continue to work

subtasks.description: Add error toast notification to EmployeeForm.tsx when mutation fails. Currently only shows success path. Use existing toast pattern from codebase (likely sonner or shadcn toast).
acceptanceCriteria: Error caught shows toast with error message
isSubmitting state properly reset on error

subtasks.description: Browser-CLI E2E verification of GDPR fixes. Test consent creation flow triggers audit log, verify CSP headers in network response, test error toast appears on simulated failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigate to employer portal, add employee, verify audit log entry via Convex CLI
Check network response headers include Content-Security-Policy

phases.gateCondition: All GDPR fixes implemented and verified via Browser-CLI. Typecheck passes. No console errors.

Tests cover empty state, list rendering, interaction

subtasks.description: Create src/pages/employer/__tests__/Bookings.test.tsx. Test booking list, status filters, new booking button state (disabled when pending verification).

Create src/pages/employer/__tests__/Settings.test.tsx. Test settings form rendering, form validation, save button state.

subtasks.description: Create src/pages/admin/__tests__/EmployerVerification.test.tsx. Test pending employer list, verify/reject button actions, empty state.

Update vitest.config.ts to expand coverage to all portals. Add src/pages/employer/**, src/pages/admin/**, src/components/** to coverage.include. Add coverage thresholds: statements 60%, branches 50%, functions 60%, lines 60%.
Browser-CLI verification of test infrastructure. Run npm test, capture output, verify all new tests pass. Run coverage report and capture metrics.

phases.name: Sprint 9: Code Quality - Modularization
phases.description: Split availableSlots.ts (659 lines) into modular structure following facade pattern, add JSDoc to core backend files

subtasks.description: Create convex/availableSlotsModules/types.ts. Extract interfaces ProposedSlot, SlotConflict and add type definitions for slot status, validation results.
Create convex/availableSlotsModules/queries.ts. Move getAvailable, getByDateRange, getByMonth, getTemplates query implementations.
Create convex/availableSlotsModules/mutations.ts. Move createSlots, blockSlot, unblockSlot, deleteTemplateSlots mutation implementations.
Create convex/availableSlotsModules/recurring.ts. Move previewRecurringSlots, createRecurringSlots implementations and helper functions for slot generation.
Create convex/availableSlotsModules/index.ts. Re-export all module contents for clean imports.
Transform convex/availableSlots.ts to facade pattern. Replace implementations with re-exports from modules. Keep <100 lines. Maintain api.availableSlots.* compatibility.
Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to convex/appointments.ts. Document all exported queries/mutations with @param, @returns, @throws, @example.
Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to convex/gdpr.ts. Focus on GDPR compliance context, data retention notes, audit logging behavior.
Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to convex/patients.ts. Document soft-delete behavior, GDPR redaction, employer ownership.
Browser-CLI verification of modularization. Test doctor schedule page still works (createSlots, recurring slots, blocking). Verify no UI regressions.

phases.gateCondition: availableSlots.ts refactored to <100 lines facade. All slot operations work via Browser-CLI test. JSDoc added to 3 core files.

phases.name: Sprint 10: Performance Optimizations
phases.description: Add aggregated dashboard query, data retention scheduler, and Vite bundle splitting

subtasks.description: Create getDashboardStats query in convex/employers.ts (or new convex/dashboard.ts). Single query that returns: employeeCount, upcomingAppointments, recentReports, pendingActions. Replaces 4 separate queries on employer dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns all dashboard stats in one response

subtasks.description: Update src/pages/employer/Dashboard.tsx to use aggregated getDashboardStats query. Replace multiple useQuery calls with single query. Update component to handle new data shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduced network requests (verify via network tab)

subtasks.description: Create convex/crons/dataRetention.ts. Implement scheduled function to: 1) Delete audit logs > 90 days, 2) Archive completed erasure requests > 30 days, 3) Clean expired OAuth states (already handled but verify).
acceptanceCriteria: Batch deletion with limits (100 per run)

subtasks.description: Register data retention cron job in convex/crons.ts. Schedule weekly run (Sunday 2am UTC). Import and configure the retention function.
Add manualChunks configuration to vite.config.ts for bundle splitting. Create chunks for: vendor (react, react-dom), ui (shadcn components), convex (convex client), workos (auth).
acceptanceCriteria: Initial load reduced (verify with npm run build)

subtasks.description: Browser-CLI performance verification. Navigate to employer dashboard, measure load time, verify single network request for dashboard data, check bundle sizes in network tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard loads with single aggregated query
Bundle chunks visible in network tab

phases.gateCondition: Aggregated dashboard query working. Data retention cron registered. Bundle splitting configured. Performance verified via Browser-CLI.
